title: Microsoft Teams: enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
summary: Hold: the briefing reverses the roadmap's meeting direction, applying improvements for devices joining Teams meetings to Teams Rooms joining other platforms. It also omits the documented fallback from SIP to Direct Guest Join and the mailbox prerequisite for preserving invitation text.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Enabling SIP calling makes the room use SIP instead of WebRTC for enabled third-party meetings.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms will automatically use Direct Guest Join over WebRTC if the third party meeting invite doesn't contain a SIP dial string. ... Automatic fallback to WebRTC DGJ works for meetings using the calendar join button.
claims.fix: Replace the unqualified SIP statement in Risk assessment and Governance guidance with 'SIP-enabled rooms use SIP for enabled third-party meetings, but automatically fall back to DGJ over WebRTC for calendar-joined invitations without a SIP dial string; join by ID fails when the meeting lacks SIP capabilities.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/third-party-join.
